title: Assistant Company Secretary
description:
🚨 URGENT HIRING \| ASSISTANT COMPANY SECRETARY
 



  





 Location: Howrah, West Bengal
 



 Position: Assistant Company Secretary
 



 Joining: Immediate Joiners Only
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Assistant Company Secretary to join our team. This is a single\-contributor role with responsibility for the secretarial and corporate compliance function across our group.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Handle end\-to\-end secretarial compliances for approximately 15 group companies
 



 • Manage compliances under the Companies Act, SEBI and other applicable regulations
 



 • Handle listed company compliances and related regulatory requirements
 



 • Prior hands\-on experience in Main Board IPO processes is essential
 



 • Coordinate with statutory authorities, advisors, auditors and other external stakeholders
 



 • Independently manage statutory filings, board/committee meetings, minutes, registers and other secretarial records
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • Qualified Company Secretary (CS)
 



 • Relevant experience in handling multiple companies / group company compliances
 



 • Strong experience in Main Board IPO work is mandatory
 



 • Must be comfortable working independently as the sole contributor
 



 • Immediate joiners only
 



  





 To apply, please send your CV to jyoti.banka@aeworks.co.in
 



 Please apply only if you have relevant Main Board IPO experience and can join immediately.
